items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff reveals what Kimi Antonelli told him in his office before US GP win
items.summaryEn: Andrea Kimi Antonelli started from pole and won the United States Grand Prix, and Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff afterwards told Sky Sports F1 what his driver had said to him before the race.
detailZh: 沃尔夫透露安东内利在美国大奖赛夺冠前对他说了什么
沃尔夫透露了安东内利在美国大奖赛开始前片刻对他说的话，这位梅赛德斯车手表现得异常镇定
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
在安东内利赢得美国大奖赛后，梅赛德斯车队领队沃尔夫接受天空体育F1采访时，透露了这位车手在赛前对他说的话。
这位意大利车手在美洲赛道从杆位发车，以压倒性优势赢得比赛，拿下本赛季第九场胜利。沃尔夫表示安东内利没有表现出任何紧张迹象。
“是啊，多棒的小伙子。我之前还被问到赛前他是否紧张，我说不紧张。他只是在准备前悄悄溜进我的办公室说：‘我现在就要好好享受这一刻。说来奇怪，我完全没在想总冠军的事。’是不是很有趣？
“所以他在那里也像是在探索自己情感上正在经历什么，然后你知道，他从头到尾都发挥出色，任何时候都表现得非同寻常。”
安东内利起步后守住领先，尽管使用的是中性胎，还受益于维斯塔潘车轮打滑，成功压制住了马克斯·维斯塔潘。
“是的，没错，而且用的是中性胎，起步稍慢一些，相比软胎会损失一米，但我觉得看起来马克斯（维斯塔潘）有很多车轮打滑，所以那很好，”沃尔夫说。
当维斯塔潘改用两停策略时，梅赛德斯拒绝做出回应，让安东内利保持一停。
“策略团队今天做得非常好。我们讨论过，你知道，马克斯可能会提前进站超越我们，我们坚持决定，认为一停看起来是最快的策略。诺里斯换上硬胎后看起来非常好，所以我们保持坚定，最终结果基本和发生的情况一致。理论上它快了八秒，最终还稍微多一点。”
这位奥地利人承认这不是一个容易的决定。
“是的，我们绝对信任这些信息。我们不想因为其他人做出反应就跟着反应，这有点，你知道，目前这是一个可怕的决定，但坚持数据并相信你的数据。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿的第四名和乔治·拉塞尔的第八名让冠军争夺得以延续，但安东内利现在领先拉塞尔123分，领先汉密尔顿124分。下周末在墨西哥城进入前九名就将锁定冠军，无论他的直接竞争对手做什么。
梅赛德斯此前曾在墨西哥庆祝过，汉密尔顿在2017年和2018年在那里锁定了他的第四个和第五个世界冠军。但沃尔夫没有得意忘形。
“我想我们有一天也有刘易斯在那里。那肯定会是很多龙舌兰酒加冰。但你知道，他仍然需要在墨西哥完成比赛。”
detailEn: Toto Wolff reveals what Kimi Antonelli told him in his office before US GP win
Toto Wolff has revealed what Kimi Antonelli told him moments before the United States Grand Prix, with the Mercedes driver showing remarkable composure
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Talking to Sky Sports F1 after Kimi Antonelli won the United States Grand Prix, Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff revealed what his driver told him before the race.
The Italian driver started on pole at the Circuit of the Americas and drove a commanding race to take his ninth victory of the season. Wolff said Antonelli showed no signs of nerves.

“Yeah, what a boy, you know. I was just saying before I got a question whether he was nervous before the race and I said no, he just sneaked into my office before getting ready and said ‘I’m just going to enjoy this right now. And it’s weird, I’m not thinking about the championship at all.’ Isn’t that funny?
“So he’s on a discovery mission there also in terms of what’s happening to him emotionally and then you know he just delivered from the beginning to the end, it was exceptional at any time.”
Antonelli kept the lead from Max Verstappen at the start, despite being on the medium tyre, helped by Verstappen getting wheelspin.
“Yeah, exactly and on the medium tyre which is a little bit slower off the line, you lose a metre against the soft but I think it looked like Max had a lot of wheelspin so that was good,” Wolff said.
When Verstappen switched to a two-stop, Mercedes refused to respond and kept Antonelli on a one-stop.

“Strategy has really done a good job today. We discussed it, you know, that Max could undercut us and we stayed firm with the decision saying the one-stop looks like the fastest strategy. Norris hit the hard and looked very good, so we stayed solid and at the end it came out pretty much what happened. In theory it was eight seconds quicker and at the end it was a little bit more.”
The Austrian admitted it was not an easy call.

“Yeah, we absolutely trusted the information. We didn’t want to react because the others did, which is a little bit, you know, at the moment it’s a scary call, but stick to the data and trust your data.”

Lewis Hamilton’s fourth place and George Russell’s eighth kept the title fight alive, but Antonelli now leads Russell by 123 points and Hamilton by 124. A top-nine finish in Mexico City next weekend will seal the title, whatever his direct rivals do.
Mercedes has celebrated in Mexico before, with Hamilton clinching his fourth and fifth world titles there in 2017 and 2018. But Wolff was not getting ahead of himself.
“I think we had Lewis there one day also. It would definitely be a lot of tequila on ice. But you know, he still needs to finish the race in Mexico.”

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔：这位梅赛德斯车手在美国大奖赛上承认自己的速度“糟糕”，他最终落后基米·安东内利近一分钟。
这位梅赛德斯车手在W17赛车中表现挣扎，最终落后统治比赛并夺冠的队友安东内利七个名次、54秒；安东内利在积分榜上对拉塞尔的领先优势扩大到123分，有望本周末在墨西哥锁定世界冠军。
乔治·拉塞尔承认他的梅赛德斯赛车速度“糟糕”，这让他在美国大奖赛上仅列第八。
乔治·拉塞尔承认自己在美国大奖赛上的速度“糟糕”，这位梅赛德斯车手也不清楚为何自己会落后夺冠的队友基米·安东内利如此大的差距。
在这场56圈的比赛中，拉塞尔落后姊妹梅赛德斯赛车54秒，以第八名完赛，仅勉强保住数学上的争冠希望，进入下周的墨西哥站，安东内利有望在那里锁定总冠军。
拉塞尔在比赛第一段（stint）中保持了第六的发车位，但在唯一一次进站（pit stop）时因首圈与奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的事故被罚时五秒，接受处罚后跌至第八；当时他被判定在与迈凯伦车手缠斗时驶出赛道而获得了优势。

拉塞尔随后在最后26圈紧追同样一停的皮亚斯特里，但未能找到重新超越这位澳大利亚车手的方法。
拉塞尔告诉天空体育F1频道：“速度糟透了。简而言之就是这样。”
“五秒（罚时）让情况更糟，可能让我丢了两三个位置，但在需要的时候速度不够好。”
在美国大奖赛上，基米·安东内利起步飞快，而乔治·拉塞尔则被处以五秒罚时。
拉塞尔没有为自己缺乏竞争力找借口，并表示他目前无法立即解释为何自己在奥斯汀的这个周末如此艰难。
“就是不够快，”他补充道。
“我需要试着弄清楚原因。当你落后这么多时，这很奇怪。希望某处能找到一些答案，但目前我还没有。”
拉塞尔出了什么问题？
安东内利的这场胜利是他本赛季的第九胜，梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫认为这代表了他“迄今为止表现最好的一场比赛”。
这是梅赛德斯升级版赛车首次获胜，自空气动力学改版于10月初在马来西亚巴林大奖赛上首次亮相以来，这支世界冠军领先车队花了一些时间才发挥出它的最佳性能。
2026年美国大奖赛精彩集锦。
不过，车队表示这些改动缩小了赛车的最佳调校窗口。
谈到拉塞尔的这个周末，沃尔夫说：“乔治就是太挣扎了。我相信这是因为赛车的操作窗口太难把握了。
“在Q2他还在那里，差不多就在附近。Q3，没起作用。他说，‘这算我的。’
“而今天在比赛中，我不知道，我们卡在皮亚斯特里后面，看起来有点不公平，为什么他没能超过去。同样的引擎，同样的电能充电和释放。但我现在要去找他谈谈。”
“在一场比赛的距离里，他不可能慢54秒。”
天空体育F1评论员简森·巴顿的分析：
“乔治经历过很多艰难的比赛，但也有一些出色的比赛，而这正是真正难以理解的地方——他如何能在某些赛道上将那辆车的潜力发挥到极致，而在其他赛道上却做不到。
“奥斯汀站很艰难，因为他起步位置太靠后了。他身处车阵之中，而当你身处车阵时，有时很难向前推进。你处在乱流之中。你试图在策略上做些不同的事情，但随后却吃到五秒罚时，这让你更加落后。”
“我不认为他的速度差得那么远。在一场比赛的距离里，他不可能慢54秒。”

detailEn: George Russell: Mercedes driver admits to 'rubbish' pace in United States GP after finishing almost one minute behind Kimi Antonelli

Mercedes driver finished seven places and 54 seconds behind dominant race-winning team-mate Kimi Antonelli after struggle in the W17 car; Antonelli poised to clinch the world championship this weekend in Mexico after growing lead over Russell to 123 points
George Russell admits the pace of his Mercedes was 'rubbish ', leaving him eighth at the United States GP.
George Russell admitted his pace in the United States Grand Prix was "rubbish", with the Mercedes driver at a loss to why he trailed race-winning team-mate Kimi Antonelli by such a large margin,

Russell finished 54 seconds behind the sister Mercedes in the 56-lap race in an eighth place that only just kept him in mathematical championship contention heading to next week's race in Mexico, where Antonelli is set to clinch the crown.

Russell had held his grid position of sixth through the race's first stint but dropped to eighth after serving a five-second penalty at his sole pit stop for an incident with Oscar Piastri in the opening lap, when he was judged to have gained an advantage by running off track in battle with the McLaren.

Russell subsequently spent the final 26 laps on the similarly one-stopping Piastri's tail but was unable to find a way back past the Australian driver.
Russell told Sky Sports F1: "The pace was rubbish. That's the long and short of it.
"The five-second [penalty] didn't help things and probably cost me two or three positions but the pace wasn't good enough when it needed to be."
Kimi Antonelli got a flying start at the United States Grand Prix as George Russell was handed a five-second penalty.
Russell made no excuse for his lack of competitiveness and said he had no immediate answer for why his Austin weekend was such a struggle.
"Just not been quick enough," he added.
"I need to try and understand why that is. It's strange when you're so far off. Hopefully there are some answers somewhere but at the moment I don't have them."
What went wrong for Russell?
Antonelli's win was his ninth of the year and represented what Toto Wolff, Mercedes' team principal, believes was "the best race that he's delivered so far".

It was the first win for Mercedes upgraded car, which has taken time for the world championship leaders to get the best out out of since the aerodynamic revisions debut at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia at the start of October.
Highlights from the 2026 United States Grand Prix.
The team have said, however, that the changes have narrowed the car's optimum set-up window.
On Russell's weekend, Wolff said: "George just struggled so much. And I believe this is because the operational window of the car is so difficult.
"In Q2 he was there and thereabouts. Q3, it didn't work. He said, 'that goes on me'.

"And today in the race, I don't know, we got stuck behind Piastri, which looks a bit unfair why he didn't get past. It's the same engine, it's the same electric charging and deployment. But I'm going to see him now."
'He's not 54 seconds slower over a race distance'
Analysis from Sky Sports F1's Jenson Button:

"George has had a lot of tough races but also some great races and that's the thing that's really difficult to understand - how he's able to get the maximum out of that car on some tracks but not at others.

"Austin was difficult as he started so far down. He was in the pack and when you're in the pack, sometimes it's difficult to move forward. You're in the dirty air. You try to do something different with strategy but then you get a five-second penalty which puts you back further.
"I don't believe his pace is that far off. He's not 54 seconds slower over a race distance."

items.originalTitle: How will Kimi Antonelli become F1 world champion at Mexico GP?
detailZh: 基米·安东内利如何在墨西哥大奖赛成为F1世界冠军？
梅赛德斯车手有望赢得他个人的F1冠军
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队
基米·安东内利通过在周日的美国大奖赛中从杆位发车并统治比赛，又迈出了成为一级方程式世界冠军的重要一步。
梅赛德斯车手因此赢得了2026赛季的第九场胜利，这让他一只手已经触及了冠军奖杯——尽管这已经有一段时间了。
那么，他什么时候能完成这一壮举，成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军呢？
有多少车手还能赢得2026年的F1冠军？
在奥斯汀赛前，有六位数学上的竞争者——安东内利、乔治·拉塞尔、刘易斯·汉密尔顿、马克斯·维斯塔潘、查尔斯·勒克莱尔和兰多·诺里斯——因为139分差距，还有150分在德克萨斯州之前的比赛中可用。
其中三人——维斯塔潘、勒克莱尔和诺里斯——现在已经退出了竞争，因为他们分别获得了第三、第二和第五名。虽然都是稳定的表现，但这只是表明他们获得世界冠军的可能性非常小，因为这意味着他们的希望已经结束。
安东内利要想在美洲赛道成为冠军，他需要赢得比赛，而拉塞尔排名第九或以下，汉密尔顿排名第五。但鉴于他的梅赛德斯车队队友排名第八，而他接替的银箭车队车手排名第四，比赛将继续到下个周末。
安东内利如何在墨西哥大奖赛成为世界冠军
在2026赛季还剩下125个积分可用，剩余五轮比赛——墨西哥、圣保罗、拉斯维加斯、卡塔尔和阿布扎比——前提是中东大奖赛在冲突中得以进行。
拉塞尔现在落后安东内利123分，汉密尔顿落后124分，因此这位20岁的意大利人几乎可以确定将在赫曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道夺得冠军。在那场比赛之后，还剩下100分，但其他两位车手必须落后安东内利99分或更少，因为本赛季冠军领跑者以较大的优势赢得了最多的胜利——所以他将在积分平局中获胜。
这意味着他们两人必须分别比安东内利多出24分和25分。因此，对于拉塞尔来说，这意味着他必须获胜，而他的队友成绩不能高于第10名，而对于汉密尔顿来说，他也必须获胜，但安东内利不能获得任何积分。
detailEn: How will Kimi Antonelli become F1 world champion at Mexico GP?
The Mercedes driver is set to win his maiden F1 crown
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing
Kimi Antonelli has taken another giant step towards becoming Formula 1 world champion by dominating the United States Grand Prix from pole on Sunday.
The Mercedes driver consequently took his ninth victory of the 2026 season and it leaves him with one hand on the championship trophy - though it has been for a while.
So, when will he do it and become F1’s youngest ever world champion?
How many drivers can still win the F1 2026 title?

There were six mathematical contenders heading into Austin - Antonelli, George Russell, Lewis Hamilton, Max Verstappen, Charles Leclerc and Lando Norris - as 139 points separated the drivers with 150 left available pre-Texas.

Three of those - Verstappen, Leclerc and Norris - have now dropped out of contention though, due to them finishing third, second and fifth respectively. All solid results, but it just shows how unlikely world championship glory was for them as it meant their hopes had ended.

For Antonelli to become champion at Circuit of the Americas, he needed to win with Russell finishing ninth or below and Hamilton taking fifth. But as his Mercedes team-mate took eighth and the Ferrari driver, who he succeeded at the Silver Arrows, finished fourth, the fight goes on to next weekend.
How Antonelli becomes world champion at Mexico GP

There are now 125 points left available in the 2026 campaign with five rounds remaining - Mexico, Sao Paulo, Las Vegas, Qatar and Abu Dhabi - provided the Middle Eastern grands prix go ahead amid the conflict.

Russell is now 123 points behind Antonelli and Hamilton is 124, so the 20-year-old Italian is all-but certain to take the crown at Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez. After that race there will be 100 points left on the table, but the other two must be behind Antonelli by 99 or fewer, due to the championship leader having the most wins this season by a comfortable margin - so he would win it on countback.

This means both must outscore Antonelli by 24 and 25 points respectively. So for Russell, that entails him winning and his team-mate finishing no higher than 10th, while for Hamilton, he must also take victory but Antonelli not take any points.

items.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利将在下周末的墨西哥大奖赛上再次争取首个F1冠军，尽管在美国大奖赛中他险些夺冠。

items.originalTitle: How Kimi Antonelli can clinch his maiden F1 championship in Mexico
detailZh: 如何基米·安东内利在墨西哥赢得他的首个F1冠军
基米·安东内利在赢得美国大奖赛胜利后，将前往墨西哥大奖赛，再次争取赢得他的首个一级方程式冠军
对于梅赛德斯车队的粉丝来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析，来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯的消息。
基米·安东内利将在下周末的墨西哥大奖赛中再次争取赢得他的首个一级方程式冠军，因为在奥斯汀的比赛中他险些赢得冠军。
20岁的车手在美国大奖赛中将杆位转化为本赛季的第九场胜利，但刘易斯·汉密尔顿的第四名和乔治·拉塞尔的第八名至少让冠军争夺战持续到下周。
基米·安东内利在墨西哥如何赢得F1冠军？
如果安东内利下周日在墨西哥城的比赛中排名前十，他将成为冠军。在这种情况下，拉塞尔和汉密尔顿的表现将无关紧要。
如果巴西、拉斯维加斯、卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛中一切顺利，墨西哥之后还剩下四场比赛，最多可以获得100分。安东内利需要在墨西哥大奖赛中至少比两位对手领先100分。
即使拉塞尔在墨西哥获胜而安东内利排名第九，他也只能将差距缩小到正好100分，然后他必须赢得剩下的四场比赛，同时安东内利不得得分。但即便如此，安东内利仍将通过积分反超赢得冠军。他本赛季已经赢得了九场大奖赛，而拉塞尔赢得了三场，最多只能达到八场。
如果基米·安东内利在墨西哥的比赛中未能进入前十名，他还能赢得冠军吗？
是的。即使安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛中未能得分，只要拉塞尔和汉密尔顿都没有赢得比赛，他仍然会是冠军。
只有当拉塞尔获胜而安东内利排名第十或更低，或者汉密尔顿获胜而安东内利未能进入积分榜时，冠军争夺战才会移至巴西。
F1美国大奖赛之后，车手积分榜排名如何？
detailEn: How Kimi Antonelli can clinch his maiden F1 championship in Mexico
Kimi Antonelli heads to the Mexican GP with another chance to secure his maiden Formula 1 championship after his United States GP victory
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Kimi Antonelli will have another chance to claim his maiden Formula 1 championship at next weekend's Mexican Grand Prix after narrowly missing out on securing the title in Austin.

The 20-year-old converted pole position into his ninth win of the season at the United States Grand Prix, but Lewis Hamilton's fourth place and George Russell's eighth kept the title fight alive for at least another week.
What does Kimi Antonelli need to do to win the F1 title in Mexico?
If Antonelli finishes in the top nine in Mexico City next Sunday, he will be champion. It would not matter what Russell and Hamilton do in that scenario.

After Mexico, four races remain if all goes as planned in Brazil, Las Vegas, Qatar and Abu Dhabi, with a maximum of 100 points available. Antonelli needs to finish the Mexican Grand Prix at least 100 points clear of both rivals.

Even if Russell won in Mexico and Antonelli finished ninth, he would only cut the gap to exactly 100, and he would then have to win all four remaining races while Antonelli failed to score. But even then, Antonelli would win the title on countback. He already has nine grand prix wins this season, while Russell has three and could only reach a maximum of eight.
Can Kimi Antonelli still win the title if he finishes outside the top nine in Mexico?
Yes. Even if Antonelli fails to score at the Mexican Grand Prix, he will still be champion as long as neither Russell nor Hamilton wins the race.
The only way the title fight goes to Brazil is if Russell wins and Antonelli finishes 10th or lower, or Hamilton wins and Antonelli finishes outside the points.

items.titleZh: 安东内利美国大奖赛夺冠，距离成为最年轻F1世界冠军一步之遥
items.summaryZh: 安东内利采用单停策略赢得美国大奖赛，尽管梅赛德斯车队队友乔治·拉塞尔努力获得第八名，刘易斯·汉密尔顿获得第四名，但安东内利仍然距离成为最年轻F1世界冠军仅一步之遥。
items.originalTitle: Antonelli on the brink of first F1 title after crushing US GP win
detailZh: 基米·安东内利采用单停策略赢得美国大奖赛，尽管梅赛德斯车队队友乔治·拉塞尔努力获得第八名，刘易斯·汉密尔顿获得第四名，但安东内利仍然距离成为最年轻F1世界冠军仅一步之遥。
这是他本赛季的第九场胜利，尽管20岁的他将至少还要等待一个周末，因为梅赛德斯车队队友乔治·拉塞尔努力获得第八名，而刘易斯·汉密尔顿获得第四名。
安东内利最终战胜了查尔斯·勒克莱尔的法拉利和红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘。
他们也是按照这个顺序出发的，安东内利在中等轮胎上领先出发，勒克莱尔在第一个弯道前挤过了维斯塔潘，因为红牛在第一个弯道下山时似乎在抓地力和/或动力上遇到了困难。
维斯塔潘在第一圈结束前就超过了勒克莱尔，通过最后一段多个右转序列的第一部分完成了超越，但安东内利此时已经建立了两秒的领先优势——他在第一圈练习中稳步扩大了这个优势，直到维斯塔潘在13圈结束时进入维修区打开停车窗口。
这使得他采用了两停策略——红牛选择给他换上另一套软胎——练习圈数的差异意味着一旦领跑者停车，他确实领先了，尽管勒克莱尔正在逼近，安东内利也迅速接近。
在56圈的比赛中途，维斯塔潘抱怨说他的车“肯定有问题，开不动了”，当时领先勒克莱尔2.1秒，尽管他设法保持了法拉利的车尾，但随后在33/56圈进入维修区，换上中性胎进行最后一圈练习——红牛选择避免使用在对手的小红牛22上表现良好的硬胎，但在伊萨克·哈吉亚的小红牛22上效果不佳。
一旦红牛车队退出比赛，安东内利只需要多半个圈就能通过超越勒克莱尔进入12号弯的刹车区来夺回领先，尽管此时梅赛德斯车队已经承诺采用一停策略，并将安东内利放在了硬胎上，但仍然觉得停了第二次车换上硬胎的法拉利构成了更大的威胁。
这确实发生了；维斯塔潘在追上兰多·诺里斯的麦凯轮车队时难以取得进展，尽管他最终通过了一次精准的冲刺进入第1弯道——当时他看起来很容易被勒克莱尔在最后一个弯道出来时超越——但维斯塔潘只保持了三圈的第二名，然后勒克莱尔超了过去。
此时，勒克莱尔已经没有时间发起挑战了——安东内利的真正头疼在最后几圈是由一辆虚拟安全车引起的，这样瓦尔特里·博塔斯的凯迪拉克可以被从赛道边拖回，尽管梅赛德斯最终选择让安东内利留在赛道上而不是为他更换新胎。
最终，他的领先优势是比勒克莱尔多出13.078秒。
晚些时候的虚拟安全车可能确保了维斯塔潘保住了他的领奖台，因为汉密尔顿（他采取了法拉利车队队友勒克莱尔的策略）在最后时刻发起了猛攻，但仍然落后一秒，未能获得第三名。
诺里斯将一停策略发挥得足够好，成功锁定第五名，领先于第三名的哈德贾，奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在第二辆麦克拉伦中排名第七。
他在比赛的下半场成功抵挡住了拉塞尔的梅赛德斯，梅赛德斯在第一圈与皮亚斯特里的战斗中因离开赛道并获得优势而被处以五秒罚时。
当时拉塞尔排名第六。
积分榜上还有小红牛车队的利亚姆·劳森和阿尔皮纳的皮埃尔·加斯利。
除了博塔斯之外，阿尔皮内（阿尔派）的弗朗科·科拉平托和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼也是其他退赛的车手。
贝尔曼的比赛非常刺激，他在比赛开始的几圈中短暂地攀升到前十名，尽管这是在通过第13号弯道时撞上加斯利的侧面之后。
贝尔曼试图声称门是被关在他身上的，但裁判员反而认为他造成了碰撞，并对他进行了处罚，他在前24圈内的三个维修区之一服刑——最后一个是导致车辆最终退赛的一次。
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli made a one-stop strategy work to win the United States Grand Prix as mid-race challenges from Mercedes' Formula 1 rivals Red Bull and Ferrari failed to materialise in the final stint.

A ninth victory of the season left Antonelli on the brink of becoming the youngest-ever F1 world champion, though the 20-year-old will be forced to wait at least one more weekend as Mercedes team-mate George Russell laboured to eighth while Lewis Hamilton finished fourth.
Antonelli ultimately won from the Ferrari of Charles Leclerc and Red Bull's Max Verstappen.

They ran in that order at the start, too, Antonelli holding the lead off the line on medium tyres and Leclerc squeezing past Verstappen into Turn 4 as the Red Bull appeared to struggle for traction and/or power on the run downhill out of the first corner.

Verstappen had made it back ahead of Leclerc before the end of the first lap, with a move through the first part of the multiple right-hand sequence in the final sector, but Antonelli had already built a buffer of two seconds by this point - an advantage he increased steadily in the first stint before Verstappen opened the pitstop window by stopping at the end of lap 13.

That put him on a two-stop strategy - Red Bull electing to put him onto another set of softs - and the offset in stint lengths meant he did end up in the lead once the frontrunners had stopped, albeit with Leclerc bearing down on him and Antonelli closing in quickly too.

Midway through the 56-lap race Verstappen complained that he "must have a problem with my car, it's undriveable" while 2.1s ahead of Leclerc, and though he managed to keep the Ferrari behind he subsequently pitted on lap 33/56 to move onto mediums for the final stint - Red Bull choosing to avoid the hard tyre that had worked well on its rivals' cars but not on Isack Hadjar's RB22.

Antonelli needed only half a lap more once the Red Bull was out of the way to reclaim the lead by overtaking Leclerc into the Turn 12 braking zone, though Mercedes - committed to a one-stop by at this point, having put Antonelli on hards - still felt the Ferrari, which stopped for a second time to also switch to hard tyres, carried the bigger threat.

That proved to be the case; Verstappen struggled to make progress as he caught the McLaren of Lando Norris, and though he did finally make his way through - with a well-judged lunge into Turn 1, when he had looked vulnerable to being passed by Leclerc exiting the final corner - Verstappen held second for only three laps more before Leclerc came through.

By this point, it was too late for Leclerc to mount a challenge - with Antonelli's only real headache in the closing laps caused by a virtual safety car called so the Cadillac of Valtteri Bottas could be recovered from the side of the track, though Mercedes ultimately opted to keep Antonelli out on track rather than pit him for fresh tyres.
In the end, his winning margin was 13.078 seconds over Leclerc.
The late VSC probably ensured Verstappen kept his podium, as a late charge from Hamilton (who matched Ferrari team-mate's Leclerc strategy) left him one second short of third place.
Norris stretched out the one-stop well enough to clinch fifth ahead of third-place starter Hadjar, with Oscar Piastri seventh in the second McLaren.

He spent the second half of the race holding off Russell's Mercedes, which had been hamstrung by a five-second penalty served at his pitstop for leaving the track and gaining an advantage while battling Piastri on the opening lap.
Russell had been sixth at the time.
The points scorers were completed by Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson and Alpine's Pierre Gasly.
Aside from Bottas, Franco Colapinto (Alpine) and Ollie Bearman (Haas) were the other drivers to retire.
Bearman's race was an eventful one, as he briefly climbed into the top 10 in the opening laps, albeit only after clattering into the side of Gasly through Turn 13.

Bearman tried to claim the door had been closed on him but the stewards instead found him guilty of causing a collision and handed him a penalty, which he served at one of three pitstops inside the first 24 laps - the last of which was ultimately to retire the car.
keyPointsZh: 这是他本赛季的第九场胜利
安东内利领先出发，最终战胜勒克莱尔和维斯塔潘
keyPointsEn: This is his ninth victory of the season
Antonelli led off the line and ultimately defeated Leclerc and Verstappen
